$comment: The shadcn/ui source each component was adapted from. The file named by `upstream` is that source, unmodified, so that a later upstream change can be compared with it and merged by hand. A component with no source in the registry has `upstream: null`, the date the registry was checked, and the reason. packages/web/test/shadcn.test.js checks this file.

typography.reason: The registry has no typography item: its address answered 404 when checked. shadcn/ui shows typography as Tailwind classes on its documentation site only. Text and Heading are written in this package (RFC 0003).
